dishes.name: 辣椒炒肉
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"五花肉","amount":200,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"青辣椒","amount":150,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"蒜","amount":3,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["五花肉切薄片，青辣椒切块","锅中放油，五花肉煸炒出油","加入蒜末爆香","倒入青辣椒翻炒","加生抽盐调味，翻炒均匀即可"]
dishes.tips: ["五花肉要煸出油才香","辣椒不要炒太久"]

dishes.name: 番茄炒蛋
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"鸡蛋","amount":3,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"番茄","amount":2,"unit":"个","type":"side"},{"name":"葱","amount":1,"unit":"根","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"糖","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["鸡蛋打散，番茄切块","锅中放油，倒入蛋液炒散盛出","锅中再放油，番茄炒出汁","倒入鸡蛋，加盐糖调味","撒葱花出锅"]

dishes.name: 红烧肉
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"五花肉","amount":500,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"冰糖","amount":30,"unit":"g","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"老抽","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"料酒","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"八角","amount":2,"unit":"个","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"桂皮","amount":1,"unit":"小块","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["五花肉切方块，冷水下锅焯水","锅中放冰糖，小火炒糖色","倒入五花肉翻炒上色","加生抽老抽料酒","加热水没过肉，放八角桂皮","大火烧开转小火炖40分钟","大火收汁即可"]
dishes.tips: ["糖色要小火炒","炖的时间要够"]

dishes.name: 蒜蓉空心菜
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"空心菜","amount":300,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"蒜","amount":5,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["空心菜洗净切段","蒜切末","锅中放油，蒜末爆香","倒入空心菜大火翻炒","加盐生抽调味，炒软即可"]

dishes.name: 可乐鸡翅
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"鸡翅中","amount":500,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"可乐","amount":1,"unit":"罐","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"老抽","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"料酒","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"姜","amount":3,"unit":"片","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["鸡翅两面划刀，冷水下锅焯水","锅中放油，鸡翅煎至两面金黄","加姜片料酒","倒入可乐没过鸡翅","加生抽老抽","大火烧开转小火炖20分钟","大火收汁"]
dishes.tips: ["可乐要没过鸡翅","收汁要注意不要糊"]

dishes.name: 麻婆豆腐
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"嫩豆腐","amount":1,"unit":"盒","type":"main"},{"name":"牛肉末","amount":100,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"豆瓣酱","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"花椒粉","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蒜","amount":3,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"葱","amount":1,"unit":"根","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"淀粉","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["豆腐切小块，开水焯一下","锅中放油，牛肉末炒散","加豆瓣酱蒜末炒出红油","加适量水，倒入豆腐","小火炖5分钟","水淀粉勾芡","撒花椒粉葱花"]
dishes.tips: ["豆腐要焯水去豆腥","花椒粉最后撒"]

dishes.name: 凉拌黄瓜
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"黄瓜","amount":2,"unit":"根","type":"main"},{"name":"蒜","amount":3,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"醋","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"香油","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"辣椒油","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["黄瓜拍碎切段","蒜切末","所有调料混合","倒入黄瓜拌匀","腌制10分钟更入味"]
dishes.tips: ["黄瓜要拍不要切","腌制一下更好吃"]

dishes.name: 西红柿鸡蛋汤
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"番茄","amount":2,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"鸡蛋","amount":2,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"葱","amount":1,"unit":"根","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"香油","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["番茄切块，鸡蛋打散","锅中放油，番茄炒出汁","加适量水烧开","倒入蛋液，不要搅拌","加盐调味","撒葱花，滴香油"]
dishes.tips: ["蛋液倒入后不要立即搅拌","番茄要炒出汁"]

dishes.name: 空气炸锅烤鸡翅
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"鸡翅中","amount":500,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"料酒","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蜂蜜","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"黑胡椒","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蒜","amount":3,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["鸡翅两面划刀","所有调料混合，腌制鸡翅30分钟","空气炸锅180度预热5分钟","鸡翅放入炸篮","180度烤15分钟","翻面再烤5分钟"]
dishes.tips: ["腌制时间越长越入味","中途翻面"]

dishes.name: 酸辣土豆丝
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"土豆","amount":2,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"青辣椒","amount":1,"unit":"个","type":"side"},{"name":"干辣椒","amount":3,"unit":"个","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"醋","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蒜","amount":2,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["土豆切丝，泡水去淀粉","青辣椒切丝，蒜切末","锅中放油，干辣椒蒜末爆香","倒入土豆丝大火翻炒","加醋盐调味","加青椒丝翻炒均匀"]

dishes.name: 水煮肉片
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"猪里脊","amount":300,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"豆芽","amount":200,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"豆瓣酱","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"干辣椒","amount":10,"unit":"个","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"花椒","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蒜","amount":5,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"淀粉","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["肉片用淀粉料酒盐腌制15分钟","豆芽焯水铺碗底","锅中放油，豆瓣酱炒出红油","加水烧开，下肉片","肉片变色后连汤倒入碗中","上面撒蒜末干辣椒花椒","淋上热油"]

dishes.name: 蛋炒饭
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"米饭","amount":2,"unit":"碗","type":"main"},{"name":"鸡蛋","amount":2,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"葱","amount":1,"unit":"根","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["鸡蛋打散，葱切葱花","锅中放油，倒入蛋液炒散","倒入米饭翻炒均匀","加盐生抽调味","撒葱花出锅"]

dishes.name: 苦瓜炒肉
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"苦瓜","amount":1,"unit":"根","type":"main"},{"name":"猪肉","amount":150,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"蒜","amount":3,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"糖","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["苦瓜切片，用盐腌一下去苦味","猪肉切片，用生抽淀粉腌制","锅中放油，肉片炒散盛出","锅中再放油，蒜末爆香","倒入苦瓜翻炒","加肉片，加盐糖生抽调味"]
dishes.tips: ["苦瓜用盐腌一下去苦味","肉片要嫩"]

dishes.name: 清蒸鲈鱼
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"鲈鱼","amount":1,"unit":"条","type":"main"},{"name":"葱","amount":2,"unit":"根","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"姜","amount":5,"unit":"片","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蒸鱼豉油","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"料酒","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["鲈鱼处理干净，两面划刀","鱼身抹料酒盐，放姜片","水开后上锅蒸8分钟","倒掉蒸出的水","放葱丝，淋蒸鱼豉油","淋上热油"]
dishes.tips: ["蒸的时间不要太长","最后淋热油"]

dishes.name: 地三鲜
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"茄子","amount":1,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"土豆","amount":1,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"青椒","amount":1,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"蒜","amount":3,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["茄子土豆切滚刀块，青椒切块","锅中放油，土豆炸至金黄","茄子炸软","锅中留底油，蒜末爆香","倒入所有食材翻炒","加生抽盐调味，水淀粉勾芡"]
dishes.description: 东北经典，素菜也能很下饭

dishes.name: 紫菜蛋花汤
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"紫菜","amount":1,"unit":"片","type":"main"},{"name":"鸡蛋","amount":1,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"虾皮","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"葱","amount":1,"unit":"根","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"香油","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["紫菜撕碎放碗中","鸡蛋打散","锅中水烧开","倒入蛋液，不要搅拌","加盐虾皮调味","倒入放紫菜的碗中","撒葱花，滴香油"]
dishes.tips: ["蛋液倒入后不要搅拌","紫菜最后放"]

dishes.name: 黄焖鸡
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"鸡腿肉","amount":500,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"香菇","amount":100,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"青椒","amount":1,"unit":"个","type":"side"},{"name":"姜","amount":3,"unit":"片","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蒜","amount":3,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"老抽","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"豆瓣酱","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["鸡腿肉切块，焯水","香菇切块，青椒切块","锅中放油，姜片蒜瓣爆香","加豆瓣酱炒出红油","倒入鸡肉翻炒上色","加生抽老抽","加热水没过鸡肉，放香菇","大火烧开转小火炖20分钟","加青椒，大火收汁"]

dishes.name: 白灼虾
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"鲜虾","amount":500,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"姜","amount":3,"unit":"片","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"葱","amount":2,"unit":"根","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"料酒","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["虾剪去虾须，挑去虾线","锅中水烧开，放姜片葱段料酒","倒入虾，煮2-3分钟","虾变红弯曲即可捞出","蘸料：生抽加姜末"]
dishes.tips: ["煮的时间不要太长","挑去虾线"]

dishes.name: 炒时蔬
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"时令蔬菜","amount":300,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"蒜","amount":3,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"盐","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["蔬菜洗净切段","蒜切末","锅中放油，蒜末爆香","倒入蔬菜大火翻炒","加盐生抽调味，炒软即可"]

dishes.name: 糖醋排骨
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"排骨","amount":500,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"冰糖","amount":30,"unit":"g","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"醋","amount":3,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"料酒","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"姜","amount":3,"unit":"片","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"芝麻","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["排骨冷水下锅焯水","锅中放冰糖，小火炒糖色","倒入排骨翻炒上色","加姜片料酒生抽","加热水没过排骨","大火烧开转小火炖30分钟","加醋，大火收汁","撒芝麻"]

dishes.name: 河南烩面
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"面粉","amount":300,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"羊肉","amount":200,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"海带丝","amount":50,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"豆腐丝","amount":50,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"香菜","amount":20,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"盐","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["面粉加水和成面团，醒发30分钟","羊肉切片，用料酒盐腌制","锅中放水烧开，羊肉下锅煮熟","面团擀成大片，切成宽条","面条下锅煮熟","加海带丝豆腐丝","加盐调味，撒香菜出锅"]
dishes.description: 河南经典面食，汤鲜面筋

dishes.name: 胡辣汤
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"牛肉","amount":100,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"面筋","amount":100,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"黄花菜","amount":30,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"木耳","amount":30,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"胡椒粉","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"淀粉","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["牛肉切丁，面筋切小块","黄花菜木耳泡发","锅中放水烧开，下牛肉丁","加面筋黄花菜木耳","煮10分钟","水淀粉勾芡","加胡椒粉盐调味","滴香油出锅"]
dishes.description: 河南特色早餐，香辣开胃

dishes.name: 剁椒鱼头
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"胖头鱼头","amount":1,"unit":"个","type":"main"},{"name":"剁椒","amount":100,"unit":"g","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"姜","amount":5,"unit":"片","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蒜","amount":5,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"葱","amount":2,"unit":"根","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蒸鱼豉油","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["鱼头处理干净，两面划刀","用料酒盐腌制10分钟","盘底铺姜片葱段","鱼头放上，铺满剁椒","水开后上锅蒸15分钟","倒掉蒸出的水","淋蒸鱼豉油，撒葱花","淋热油"]

dishes.name: 小炒黄牛肉
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"黄牛肉","amount":300,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"小米辣","amount":50,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"青辣椒","amount":100,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"蒜","amount":5,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蚝油","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["牛肉切薄片，用生抽淀粉腌制","小米辣青辣椒切圈","蒜切末","锅中放油，大火烧热","牛肉下锅快速翻炒变色盛出","锅中留底油，蒜末辣椒爆香","倒回牛肉，加生抽蚝油","大火翻炒均匀出锅"]

dishes.name: 萍乡小炒肉
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"五花肉","amount":200,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"瘦肉","amount":100,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"青辣椒","amount":200,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"红辣椒","amount":100,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"蒜","amount":5,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"老抽","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["五花肉瘦肉切薄片","青红辣椒切滚刀块","蒜切末","锅中放油，五花肉煸出油","加瘦肉翻炒变色","加蒜末爆香","倒辣椒大火翻炒","加生抽老抽盐调味","翻炒均匀出锅"]

dishes.name: 三杯鸡
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"三黄鸡","amount":1,"unit":"只","type":"main"},{"name":"米酒","amount":1,"unit":"杯","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"生抽","amount":1,"unit":"杯","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"香油","amount":1,"unit":"杯","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"姜","amount":5,"unit":"片","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蒜","amount":10,"unit":"瓣","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"九层塔","amount":20,"unit":"g","type":"side"}]
dishes.steps: ["鸡切块，焯水","锅中放香油，姜片蒜瓣爆香","倒入鸡块翻炒","加米酒生抽","大火烧开转小火炖30分钟","大火收汁","加九层塔翻炒出锅"]

dishes.name: 电饭煲焖饭
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"大米","amount":2,"unit":"杯","type":"main"},{"name":"腊肠","amount":100,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"胡萝卜","amount":1,"unit":"根","type":"side"},{"name":"土豆","amount":1,"unit":"个","type":"side"},{"name":"青豆","amount":50,"unit":"g","type":"side"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"蚝油","amount":1,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["大米淘洗干净","腊肠切片，胡萝卜土豆切丁","所有食材放入电饭煲","加正常煮饭的水量","加生抽蚝油盐调味","按下煮饭键","煮好后拌匀即可"]
dishes.tips: ["水量要合适","食材可以随意搭配"]

dishes.name: 葱油拌面
dishes.ingredients: [{"name":"面条","amount":200,"unit":"g","type":"main"},{"name":"葱","amount":3,"unit":"根","type":"side"},{"name":"生抽","amount":2,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"老抽","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"糖","amount":0.5,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"},{"name":"食用油","amount":3,"unit":"勺","type":"seasoning"}]
dishes.steps: ["葱切段，葱白葱绿分开","锅中放油，小火慢慢炸葱白","葱白炸至金黄加葱绿","炸至焦黄捞出","锅中留葱油，加生抽老抽调汁","面条煮熟捞出","淋上葱油汁拌匀"]

dishes.name: 空气炸锅烤红薯
